integrated_multimodal_description: Claymation plasticine stop-motion, handcrafted modelling clay with visible fingerprints and matte finish, photographed on a miniature practical set. a small military vehicle-wash bay of riveted grey steel plates. Wet grey concrete floor, two faded yellow safety lines, one rectangular drain hole at centre with the grate lying face down beside it, red-wheel water valves and a coiled hose reel on the left wall, electric cabinets and a broom on the right wall, two stacked steel drums at rear right, ONE RIBBED STEEL ROLL-UP DOOR closed against the bay's rear steel wall, a bare chain with a hook above the drain, two caged industrial lamps hanging from the riveted steel ceiling. The interior of the bay fills the entire frame edge to edge: riveted steel walls and a riveted steel roof close the whole frame on every side and every top corner, so the view shows steel plates, caged lamps and the chain from floor to roof. Cool hard overhead light, short shadows, wet surfaces. TEO (frame left): tall thin white clay man, huge straw-blond walrus moustache, teal knitted beanie with cream stripes, red-and-black checked flannel shirt, brown suspenders, khaki trousers, dark boots. JUCA (frame right): short wide Black clay man, burnt-brown flat cap, mustard cable-knit sweater, olive-green trousers, pale wooden clogs, pencil behind the right ear. TEO and JUCA are the only two main puppets: TEO stays at frame left and JUCA stays at frame right. The military client in olive uniform appears ONLY in the shot that names him, silent, no dialogue; no other people or animals appear. All transitions between shots are INSTANT HARD CUTS on the exact cut timestamps: no cross-dissolve, no fade, no double exposure, no translucent ghost figures, no duplicated characters, no morphing between poses. AT START: A tall mustached man stands empty-handed on the left, while a shorter mustached man on the right grips the handle of a wheeled metal bucket; a shutter door, hanging chain and hook, ceiling lamps, wall phone, coiled hoses, valve, barrel, control box, floor grates, and a mop line the metal room, and the concrete floor is wet with shallow puddles between yellow lines.. [Shot 1] the opening wide frame exactly as established: TEO stands at frame left beside the wall telephone with its coiled cord looped, JUCA stands at frame right with one hand resting on the bucket cart handle, a steel drum stands planted at the rear right corner of the bay, the RIBBED STEEL ROLL-UP DOOR is closed at the back against the bay's own riveted rear steel wall, the bare chain and hook hang above the central drain, and the steel grate lies face down on the wet floor beside the drain; both puppets hold their positions, breathing, for the first beat and the military client is NOT visible yet, still hidden behind the closed curtain. The wet concrete floor keeps its shallow puddles throughout the whole clip. [Shot 2] At 00:01.500, the military client in his olive uniform steps INTO the frame from frame right, arriving from the side of the closed ribbed steel roll-up door, and holds out a folded BLANK white sheet of paper (completely smooth, no writing, no lines, no marks of any kind); the closed ribbed steel door with the bay's own riveted steel wall fills the background; TEO takes the sheet with both hands; the client points one finger down at the floor drain to mime the job, and TEO folds the blank sheet and tucks it into his flannel chest pocket before the client steps back out of frame; both heads stay fully inside the frame. [Shot 3] At 00:04.500, the camera cuts to a wide two-shot with the blank sheet already tucked inside TEO's chest pocket: TEO lifts the receiver and turns away, the cord snaps taut and the whole phone box is yanked off the wall and tumbles down onto the fallen steel grate; JUCA steadies the wobbling bucket cart beside him with one hand and keeps walking; the client is already gone behind the curtain. [Shot 4] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to a tight two-shot: TEO still holds the receiver at his ear on a cord that now leads down to a telephone on the floor. He straightens his spine, smooths his walrus moustache once and raises one flat hand at chest height - TEO never sticks his tongue out, the tongue tic belongs to JUCA alone; JUCA sets the bucket cart square beside him, adjusts his flat cap and lets his tongue slip out slightly, and both look at the fallen phone box. They do not speak and their mouths do not move, but they breathe, swallow and react with their whole bodies. AT END: phone box torn off the wall and lying on the fallen grate; receiver still in TEO's hand on the cord; the bay empty behind the curtain.
overall_soundscape: A bakelite receiver clicks off its cradle, the coiled cord creaks as it tightens, and the steel phone box bangs down on the concrete and rings. TEO snorts one short nasal breath. JUCA exhales a long flat sigh.
